mustMemoriseRules: Imperfect gives background or repeated past habits.
Useful chunks: j’étais, j’avais, c’était, il y avait.
Conditional chunks je voudrais and j’aimerais express would like.
Perfect reports a completed event; imperfect describes background/habit.
Simple future/conditional forms are light exposure, not the main production target.
